p.name: Name
p.login_vergessen: Forgot your password? An owner of your company can send you a new link.
p.totp_text: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
p.totp_schritt1: Open an authenticator app (for example 1Password, Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator).
p.totp_schritt2: Add a new account with this key:
p.totp_link: Or open this link on a device with an authenticator app
p.totp_schritt3: Enter the code the app shows now.
p.pw_regel: At least 12 characters. A sentence of several words is easy to remember.
p.wartend_leer: No device is waiting for approval.
p.firmencode_text: Employees connect the app to your company with this code (setup assistant, “WhisperLoom join” or provisioning file).
p.auto_freigabe_text: Useful for deployment via software distribution. Otherwise IT approves every new device.
p.geraete_text: Devices connect with the company code and then wait for your approval.
p.geraete_leer: No device connected yet. Enter the company code in the app; the device then appears here.
p.geraet_loeschen_text: The device loses access immediately and must connect again.
p.gruppen_text: Groups (for example departments) have their own policy. It overrides the company policy per setting.
p.richtlinie_text: Decide per setting what the company prescribes. Keyboard shortcuts always stay changeable.
p.kuerzel_hinweis: Keyboard shortcuts can only be preset, never locked.
stufe.fixed_text: Set centrally, hidden in the app.
stufe.default_text: Preset, the employee may change it.
stufe.inherit_text: The group uses the company setting.
p.schluessel_text: Provider keys are stored encrypted on the server. Only the last four characters are shown.
p.eigener_name_text: Only for “Own provider”: the provider ID from the app, for example custom.
modus.proxy_text: Keys never leave the server. The app talks to the provider through the server.
modus.distribute_text: Approved devices receive the keys and keep them in the computer's secure storage.
p.rollen_text: Owners manage admins and the company settings. Admins manage devices, groups, policy and keys.
p.einladung_einmal: The link is shown only now and works once. Pass it on securely.
p.konto_extern: You sign in through your company's upstream sign-in.
p.nur_owner_aendern: Only owners can change these settings.
p.anmeldearten_text: Which sign-in methods apply to admins of this company. You can choose from what the instance allows.
art.password_totp_text: Default. Every admin needs a code from an authenticator app.
art.password_text: Two-factor is optional. Choose only if other protection is in place.
art.trusted_header_text: Sign-in through your identity provider (for example Authelia, oauth2-proxy).
art.local_only_text: Portal reachable only directly on the server machine.
p.code_erneuern_text: The current code stops working immediately. Devices already connected stay connected.
p.instanz_text: Companies on this instance. Only each company's admins see its devices, keys and policies.
p.kurzname_text: 2–40 characters: a–z, 0–9 and hyphen. Used in command-line commands.
ok.code_neu: The new code applies from now on.
h.name: The name needs 1 to 60 characters.
h.zu_oft: Too many attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
h.pw_ungleich: The two passwords do not match.
h.pw_kurz: The password needs at least 12 characters.
h.pw_lang: The password may have at most 128 characters.
h.login_falsch: User name or password is wrong.
h.login_gesperrt: Too many attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
h.totp_falsch: The code is wrong. Please enter the current code.
h.kein_key: This does not look like a key.
h.benutzer: User name: 2–64 characters, lower-case letters, digits, dot, @, hyphen.
h.letzter_owner: The company needs at least one active owner.
h.kein_konto: This sign-in has no own account.
h.keine_art: At least one sign-in method must stay active.
h.eigene_art: Your own sign-in method must stay active, otherwise you lock yourself out.
h.richtlinie_fehler: Nothing saved: please check the marked settings.
f.neu_laden: The page was open too long or came from elsewhere. Please reload.
f.kein_zugang: There is no access here for this sign-in.
f.nur_lokal: The portal is reachable only directly on the server machine.
f.nur_owner: Only owners of the company may do this.
f.nur_instanz: This page is for instance admins only.
f.link: The link is no longer valid. Please ask for a new one.
p.sperren_auto_hinweis: New devices are approved automatically: anyone who knows the company code can connect again right away. To keep the blocked device out, renew the company code.
p.nutzung_text: How much the devices use the company proxy, per month. Only counters are stored – never dictations, texts or audio.
p.nutzung_leer: No usage in this month yet.
p.nutzung_datenschutz: Requests count once the provider has answered. Tokens as reported by the provider, audio minutes from the recording length, cost from the price table under “Budget” (estimate).
p.budget_text: Monthly caps for the proxy per company, group or device. Once a limit is reached, the proxy declines further requests until the end of the month – without a fallback provider. The app then shows “Company budget for this month reached – please ask IT”.
p.budget_leer: No budget set yet – usage is unlimited.
p.budget_grenzen_text: Leave empty for no limit. Enter at least one limit; an existing budget for the same level is replaced.
p.max_kosten_text: In the currency of the price table, e.g. 25 or 12.50.
p.preise_text: Optional, for the cost estimate: price per model as charged by your provider.
p.preise_leer: No prices stored – cost is not estimated.
p.modell_text: In proxy mode the server uses exactly this model; empty = the model sent by the app.
p.key_text: Leave empty for your own server (custom server, Ollama) without authentication.
h.url_fehlt: Your own server without a key needs an address.
h.ziel_verboten: This address points to an internal network of the server or to a port that is not allowed. The instance administrator can allow it via WL_UPSTREAM_ALLOW.
h.basis_url: The address must start with http:// or https:// and may only contain host, port and path – no #, ?, @, backslash, spaces or control characters.
h.budget_leer: Please enter at least one value.
